Good Experience
Oct 2023 • Friends
Last night, I had dinner with my friend at Sushi Hokkaido Sachi, and it left us feeling extremely satisfied. The service was excellent, and the food exceeded our expectations. The Boat Sashimi was incredibly fresh and flavorful, especially when paired with wasabi and ginger. The Wagyu Katsu was a must-try dish; it was slightly rare, and served with a hot stone, allowing us to cook it to our liking. Lastly, the Eel Roll was simply fantastic. The eel on top was tender and complemented beautifully by the Japanese sauce.
